decision_rationale: The record presents a new domain-adapted single-cell foundation model, not a review, benchmark, or wrapper. It centers on scRNA-seq data encoded as sentences and adapted with Llama/Qwen backbones, with explicit generative tasks and text-based cell templates.
evidence_snippet: "domain-adapted 8-billion-parameter Llama and Qwen backbones with either RG or GF sentences"; "single-cell expression data"; "GFencoded cell sentences"; "causal LM"; "embedding-based and generative tasks"
